name: ESMA Museum and Site of Memory
scope: July 2013 exterior of the former ESMA Officers’ Quarters, the building that later became the ESMA Museum and Site of Memory. Includes the avenue entrance, white plaster and exposed brick, clay roofs, three connected arms and the two open rear courts. The wider former naval campus and the 2015 exhibit structures are outside the 2013 scope.

review.method: Qualla first, exact creator CC0 originals after identifying conflicting story gallery paths
review.notes: Qualla was searched first. Its gallery links shift the filenames against the Commons identities. Excluded the mismatched story associations and used two independent, exact author-released originals recovered by matching the bytes in the local image corpus to their native Commons hashes. The 1928 campus image predates the 1939 Officers’ Quarters predecessor.
